answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent burns a deposit worth 30 days of earnings for one work slot per epoch. A marble workshop shows the math: one honest agent burns one deposit, while a forger wanting 100 slots burns 100 deposits. At 40 credits each, 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits, and slots expire each epoch. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted; a voyage manifest and a sable-black ledger expose repeat claims.
